title: MOST POWERFUL PSALM 121 MORNING PRAYER TO START YOUR DAY
text: Lift your hands wherever you are. Before the noise of the day begins, let the voice of faith rise first. Let the morning hear your conviction, not your complaint. Let the first sound from your house be worship. I will lift up mine eyes unto the heels. From whence cometh my help, my help cometh from the Lord which made heaven and earth. [music] Psalm 121 1:2. That is our foundation today. The psalmist did not say, "I will lift up my eyes to men, nor to systems, nor to experience." He said, "To the heels, to the place where the presence of God dwells." The morning is the gate of the day. Whoever controls it controls the traffic of ours. So we stand at this gate and proclaim, "Our help comes from the Lord." Say it until it settles in YOUR SPIRIT. MY HELP comes from the Lord, not from lock, not from men, not from connections, from the Lord. Father, we thank you for being the keeper of Israel, [music] who never sleeps nor slumbers. Thank you because the sun shall not smite us by [music] day, nor the moon by night. Thank you because you preserve our going out and our coming in. Now, oh God, arise this morning and show yourself strong. Let every voice that rose against us through the night be silenced. Let every arrow of darkness return to sender. Let every evil meeting scatter by fire. Let the blood of Jesus speak louder than accusation. Psalm 46:5. God is in the midst of her. She shall not be moved. God shall help her and that right early. So I decree help [music] comes early this morning. You will not wait till evening to see his goodness. Before the first hour ends, signs of help will appear. Some trust in chariots, some in horses, but we will remember the name of the Lord our God. Psalm 20:7. That name becomes a shield around you. Where others fall, you will stand. Where others panic, you will rejoice. Where others labor, you will receive help. Thus, sayeth the spirit of the Lord. I will lift up those whose eyes are on me. I will defend them from the arrows of the morning. I will open doors they did not knock on. Therefore, lift up your head, oh believer, your redeemer lives. He has gone ahead of you into this day. He has stationed angels at the junctions you cannot see. He has prepared answers for questions you have not yet asked. [music] Say after me, Father, I lift up my eyes to you. I refuse to begin this day in fear. I decree that the heavens are open over me. I decree that the earth will favor me. I decree that my steps are ordered by the Lord. Psalm 37:23, the steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord. So we prophesy ordered steps, ORDERED MEETINGS, ORDERED FAVOR. You will not walk into traps. You will not collide with danger. You will not be a victim of another man's error. Now let thanksgiving fill the atmosphere. Father, thank you because you kept us through [music] the night. Thank you because we are alive by mercy. Thank you because today will testify of your goodness. [music] We enthrone you as the Lord over this morning over our families, our work, our journey, our finances. Take preeminence, King of glory. Let your fire surround us as a wall. Let your peace crown our minds. Let your wisdom guide our speech. Psalm 5:12. For thou, Lord will bless the righteous. With favor will thou compass him as with a shield. By that favor we enter this day. By that favor we command results. By that favor we silence opposition. By that favor we enjoy help that men cannot explain. Hear this prophetic decree. Wherever your name is mentioned today, it will be for good. Whoever sits to discuss your matter, mercy will answer for you. Whatever was programmed against YOUR RISING, THE FIRE OF GOD CONSUMES IT NOW. EVERY SPIRIT THAT MONITORS PROGRESS, GO BLIND IN THE NAME OF JESUS. Every voice WHISPERING FAILURE AT THE EDGE OF SUCCESS, BE SILENCE FOREVER, for the Lord shall preserve you from all evil. He shall preserve your soul. Psalm 121:7, [music] I decree preservation over your life, preservation over your children, preservation over your vehicles, preservation over your finances, [music] preservation over your health, no loss, NO TRAGEDY, NO EVIL REPORT. THE SAME GOD who kept Israel keeps you this day. Now lift your right hand and declare, I walk under divine covering. My head carries oil. My mouth carries prophecy. My hands carry prosperity. My feet carry [singing] speed. My day is blessed. Isaiah 601. Arise. Shine for thy light is come. Arise this morning. Shine in your city. SHINE IN YOUR OFFICE. SHINE IN YOUR PURPOSE. DARKNESS SHALL COVER THE EARTH, but not your dwelling. While men say there is a casting down, you shall say there is a lifting up. Job 22:29 confirms it. And now, as we close this first wave, thank him again. Thank him because the keeper of Israel neither sleeps nor slumbers. Thank him because your help has located you. Thank him because angels have gone AHEAD OF YOU. THANK HIM because Psalm 121 has become flesh in your life today. Father, we seal this morning with the blood of Jesus. We decree the sun will shine for our favor. The wind will blow for our advantage and the earth will yield her increase to us in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen. The psalmist said, "The Lord is thy keeper. The Lord is thy shade upon thy right hand. That is not poetry. That is covenant language. The keeper means the guardian of boundaries, the defender of inheritance. He keeps not only your body but your breath, your mind, your seasons. So before you step out, declare aloud, "The Lord is my keeper." Say it until faith rises. The Lord is my keeper. My soul is kept, my journey is kept, my dreams are kept, my family is kept. Psalm 125:2, as the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the Lord is round about his people from henceforth, even forever. That means divine security is not seasonal. It is continuous. Even when you are asleep, the circle of fire remains. Therefore, by that word, I decree a circle of fire around your house, around your children, around your work. No evil shall penetrate it. No loss shall breach it. No arrow shall break through it. Father, this morning we invoke the covenant of preservation. Let the blood speak better things than accusation. Let the mark of Christ silence the mark of death. Let the angel of destruction pass over every home marked by the blood. Let no tragedy befall the righteous. Let no sudden call of sorrow come. Let no weapon formed prosper. Isaiah 54:17. No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper. And every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. We condemn them now. We condemn every negative prediction. We condemn every evil decree. We condemn every manipulation projected into this day. By the mercy of God, we establish preservation. Beloved, preservation is the proof that you are valuable to God. He does not guard what he does not treasure. [music] You are his heritage and heaven invests resources [music] to keep you. Psalm 91:11, for he shall give his angels charge over thee to [music] keep thee in all thy ways. There are angels already stationed along your roots today. At the intersection where danger waits, an angel [music] stands with drawn sword. At the office where envy plants a snare, an angel stands as advocate. At the hospital where a diagnosis was written, an angel stands to cancel it. You are not walking alone. Unseen escorts go before you. Lift your voice and decree. Father, I receive angelic ministry this morning. Let angels bear me up. Let angels fight for me. Let angels guide me. Let angels announce me. Let angels preserve me. Hebrews 1:14 calls them ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation. Therefore, heirs of salvation receive ministry of angels right now. Someone under the sound of my voice, every time you wake, fear greets you before the sunlight. You imagine accidents, failures, losses. Hear the word of the Lord. Fear not, for he has given his angels charge concerning you. This morning, the spirit of fear is rebuked. Your confidence returns. Your mind receives peace. Your heart receives calm. The storm within you becomes [music] still. Philippians 4:7. And the peace of God which passes all understanding shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus. That peace guards you like armor. It is stronger than anxiety. Now place your right hand upon your head. Every morning carries an anointing for direction. You will not stumble through this day. You will not choose wrongly. You will not invest where heaven has not approved. [music] You will not travel when evil waits on that road. The keeper of Israel [music] will whisper to your spirit, "This is the way. Walk in it." Isaiah 30:21, "Thine ears [music] shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way. Walk ye in it. Receive prophetic sensitivity. Receive discernment. Receive accuracy. Let the lamp of the Lord search your inner man and expose [music] every trap before you step into it. Father, let the covenant of preservation [music] cover the works of our hands. Let businesses be protected from collapse. Let jobs be preserved from redundancy. Let [music] ideas be preserved from theft. Let finances be preserved from wastage. Let favor be preserved from corruption. Everything you have given us, keep by your power. 1 Peter 1:5, who are kept by the power of God to faith unto salvation. We are kept by power, not luck. We are kept by mercy, not strategy. We are kept by covenant, not coincidence. And because we are kept, we will see the end of this day in peace. >> [music] >> Now declare these words with authority. Let your atmosphere hear them. [music] I decree and declare this day. No weapon succeeds against me. I decree [music] and declare I am surrounded by angels. I decree and declare my going out is blessed. My coming in is blessed. I decree and declare the arrows of the wicked fall before they are shot. I decree and [singing] declare the Lord himself is my keeper. Psalm 3 colon 3. But thou, oh Lord, art a shield for me, my glory and the lifter up of mine head. Your head will not bow in shame today. Grace will lift it. The glory of the Lord will shine upon it. The sun shall not smite you by day, nor the moon by night. [music] Psalm 121:6. That means no heat of pressure will drain your strength and no chill of night will quench [music] your passion. You are preserved in the heat and preserved in the [music] cold. Now thank him. Thank him because the morning has heard your decree. Thank him because angels are moving already. Thank him because the covenant of preservation has been activated. Say, "Father, thank you. I am kept. My family is kept. [music] My purpose is kept. My destiny is secure in your hands. And now we seal this wave. May the Lord surround you like the mountains surround Jerusalem. May the fire upon your altar never go out. May your eyes behold the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living. May the peace [music] of God accompany you through every hour of this day in Jesus mighty name. Amen. Every new dawn carries battles on sin. But greater is he that is in you than he that is in the world. We rise this morning not as beggars but as warriors redeemed by blood. Psalm 121:7. The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil. He shall preserve thy soul. That is not a wish. It is a decree from the [music] throne. Every form of evil, spiritual, physical, financial, emotional bows to that word. Father, we stand upon that covenant and make war in righteousness. Every power assigned to waste destinies at the break of day SCATTER BY FIRE. Every spirit that calls names for destruction, WE CANCEL YOUR VOICE. EVERY ALTAR that rises early to exchange glory, WE SILENCE YOU NOW by the blood of Jesus. Let the handwriting of misfortune be blotted out. LET EVERY PROJECTION OF FAILURE RETURN TO SENDER. LET EVERY cause of limitation break under the weight of mercy. Somebody listening. You send cycles repeating. Just when good news is near, something cuts it off. Hear the word of the Lord. That pattern ends this morning. Nahome 1 9 affliction shall not rise up. The second time we announce in THE SPIRIT, NO REPETITION OF SORROW, NO REPETITION OF LOSS, NO REPETITION OF SHAME, THE SIEGE is broken. Decree now, by the covenant of Psalm 121, I escape evil repetition. By the covenant of preservation, I break ANCESTRAL DELAY. BY THE MERCY OF GOD, I WALK INTO NEW CYCLES OF VICTORY. Now we contend for our families. Leave the names of your household before God. Father, remember every mother, father, spouse, child, BROTHER, SISTER CONNECTED TO US BY BLOOD OR COVENANT. Let the same covering that KEEPS US REST UPON THEM. LET THE SHADOW OF THE ALMIGHTY STRETCH ACROSS OUR GENERATIONS. Let every agent of death, disease, and despair be dismissed FROM OUR HOMES. EXODUS 12:23. The Lord will pass over the door AND WILL NOT SUFFER THE DESTROYER TO COME IN. We mark our FAMILIES WITH THE BLOOD OF JESUS. WE MARK OUR DOORS, OUR CARS, OUR WORKPLACES, NO CALAMITY, NO ACCIDENT, NO STRANGE CALL, NO SUDDEN GRIEF. OUR HOMES ARE TABERNACLES OF LIFE. OUR BEDS ARE ALTARS OF PEACE. OUR CHILDREN ARE SIGNS and wonders. I speak to parents, your children will not be victims of this age. They will not wander into confusion. They will not be taken by addiction. They will not be lost to the streets. Isaiah 54:13. All thy children shall be taught of the Lord, and great shall be the peace of thy children. [music] We prophesy peace upon their minds, purity upon their hearts, purpose upon their feet. Wherever they go, the Lord goes before them. Now leave the photo, the name, or the memory of anyone connected to [music] you. Declare, "Father, by this morning's covenant, none among us shall be small. None among us shall die before time. None among us shall be wasted." We rise as a family remembered by mercy. The spirit of God says, "I am overturning demonic verdicts spoken in the night. Every dream of coffin, every image of loss, every symbol of backwardness BE NULLIFIED. LET FIRE ANSWER FIRE. LET THE GOD WHO ANSWERS BY FIRE SILENCE the gatherings of darkness. 1 Kings 18:38 Then the fire of the Lord fell. Let that same fire fall now on every altar of witchcraft. Every monitoring spirit, every marine covenant, every evil network speaking AGAINST YOUR HOUSEHOLD. FIRE OF GOD, CONSUME IT. Psalm 68:1, "Let God arise. Let his enemies be scattered. We command scattering now. Enemies of progress, scatter. Enemies of health scatter. Enemies of promotion scatter. Enemies of purpose scatter. The Lord arises within our gates. Now speak to your destiny. CALL IT BY NAME. DESTINY. HEAR THE WORD OF THE LORD. AWAKE FROM SLUMBER. EVERY VIRTUE buried under fear. Resurrect. Every gift locked by ignorance. OPEN. EVERY DOOR CLOSED by envy. Unlock every helper delayed by confusion. Locate me speedily. Isaiah 45:2. I will [music] go before thee and make the crooked places straight. Therefore, Lord, go before us this day. Straighten financial parts, straighten relational parts, straighten ministerial parts. Every rough edge become smooth. Every mountain bow. Every valley rise. [screaming] EVERY CROOKED way align to destiny. Some of you have carried battles older than your age. You inherited struggles you did not start. But the cross is the place where generational handwriting is erased. Colossians 2:15. Having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a show of them openly. We enforce that victory. We announce to the bloodlines of failure, the curse expires here. We proclaim jubilee over our foundations. From today only blessing speaks. From today only favor speaks. FROM TODAY ONLY LIFE SPEAKS. SAY ALOUD, I am a new creature. Old things have passed away. My lineage is redefined by the blood of Jesus. Every limitation OF MY FATHER'S HOUSE, I bury you now. Now begin to release prophetic fire over your environment. Speak to the air, carry only messages of favor. Speak to the earth, yield increase for me. Speak to the sun, SHINE FOR MY ADVANCEMENT. SPEAK TO THE WIND. BLOW OPPORTUNITIES my way. Everything created hears the voice of the creator through your tongue. Job 22:28. Thou shalt also decree a thing and it shall be established unto thee. So we decree establishment of peace, of favor, of divine remembrance. LET WICKED ARROWS BUT FIRE. LET SNARES BE EXPOSED. Let every hidden enemy confess defeat before midday. Let every sickness dissolve like mist before the rising sun. Let every burden lift off shoulders. Let every fear evaporate. Now thank him. Thank him because your destiny has been preserved. Thank him BECAUSE YOUR FAMILY HAS BEEN SHIELDED. THANK HIM because the MORNING HAS HEARD YOUR ROAR. THANK HIM BECAUSE THE GOD OF PSALM 121 STANDS GUARD OVER EVERY MOMENT of your day. Say, "Father, I thank you. I am covered. I am remembered. I am advancing. My family is safe. My destiny is fruitful. My atmosphere is holy. And now by this decree go forth into the day. No evil shall befall you. No arrow shall LOCATE YOU. NO POWER SHALL STOP YOU. YOU will walk in peace. Harvest in joy and return in THANKSGIVING IN THE NAME OF JESUS CHRIST. AMEN. Every morning heaven dispatches help to those who ask. Psalm 121:E2, [music] "My help cometh from the Lord which made heaven and earth." Heaven and earth are his workshop. Your miracle is already in production. The same God who framed the universe can frame your day for favor. Father, we thank you because you are the help of the helpless. You help the weak to stand, the poor to rise, the forgotten to be remembered. We invoke your help this morning. Let doors that resisted effort [music] open by mercy. Let opportunities hidden in shadows appear. Let the wind of divine assistance blow from the north, south, east, [music] and west. Psalm 46:1 God is our refuge and [music] strength, a very present help in trouble. Therefore, every situation crying [music] impossible, hear the word of the Lord. Help has arrived. Help in your office, help in your household, help in [music] your projects, help in your health, help in your destiny. Beloved, angelic traffic is real. Jacob saw them ascending and descending. [music] That ladder still stands over believers this morning. Let that ladder be reestablished over your life. [music] We summon angelic presence, messengers of prosperity, of guidance, of protection. Let angels enter bank halls, offices, courts, and classrooms on your behalf. Let them speak where you cannot speak. Defend where you cannot stand. Hebrews 1:14. [music] Are they not all ministering spirits? Send forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation. You are that he air. [clears throat] Therefore, ministry begins now. [music] Angels of favor locate contracts. Angels of healing enter hospitals. Angels of restoration gather scattered blessings. Angels of war chase away adversaries. Angels of mercy mark every threshold of danger. Say aloud, I receive angelic assistance this morning. The same angel that rolled away the stone at the tomb will roll away obstacles before you. The same angel that delivered Peter from prison will open every iron gate in your path. The same angel that stood by Paul in the storm will guide you through today's uncertainty now contend for breakthrough. Every help delayed appear. Every approval held back be released. Every closed door labeled not yet open by divine urgency. Every helper who forgot you, remember now. Every policy working against you, REVERSE. EVERY EMBARGO sitting on your promotion, lift. Isaiah 45:1-2. Thus sayeth the Lord to his anointed. I will loose the loins of kings to open before him the two leave gates, and the gates shall not be shut. We enforce it. Double gates open. Hidden keys appear. Kings remember systems yield. By this prophetic word, you move from waiting to walking, from striving to soaring. Someone listening right now, you've reached the end of human help. The spirit of the Lord says, "I am stepping in." Where you thought the season was over, divine intervention begins. You will look back and say, "Surely the Lord helped me." Psalm 118:23. This is the Lord's doing. It is marvelous in our eyes. So declare, "Lord, surprise me today with lastm minute miracles. Surprise me with calls I did not expect. Surprise me with provision I DID NOT PLAN. SURPRISE ME WITH FAVOR I DID NOT DESERVE. Let my life be evidence that you still help [music] men. Now, we rebuke the spirit of delay. Delay is an enemy of help. It makes answered prayers look as though God ignored them. But Daniel 10 12-13 shows us that the prince of Pesia withheld the answer until a stronger angel came. So Lord, send stronger angels this morning. Every satanic resistance to help bow. Every demonic checkpoint [music] scatter. EVERY BUREAUCRATIC MOUNTAIN MELT. EVERY SPIRITUAL EMBARGO BREAK. LET speed return to every pending [singing and music] testimony. Habac 2:3. Though it tar, wait for it, it shall surely [screaming] come, it will not tarry. That surely is your covenant. You will not wait in vain. You will testify in time. Lift both hands now. Say, "Father, I receive supernatural speed. Where others crawl, I will fly. Where others are stranded, I will advance. Where others guess, I will know. By the spirit of God, I move swiftly." 1 Kings 18 46. And the hand of the Lord was on Elijah, and he ran before Ahab. The hand of the Lord rest on you. Speed in career, speed in restoration, SPEED IN RESULTS, SPEED in destiny fulfillment. You will overtake those who mocked you. YOU WILL RECOVER YEARS in days. WHAT WAS PENDING SINCE JANUARY WILL manifest before the month ends. Now bless the Lord for help that has come. Thank him because angels are already on assignment. Thank him because his hand of speed is upon you. Thank him because Psalm 121 is alive in your life. Say, "Father, I thank you. The Lord is my keeper. The Lord is my helper. [music] I walk into doors I did not knock on. I find answers I did not search for. This day will speak of mercy, favor, and help. And now we seal this wave with a decree. Your morning is helped. Your labor is helped. Your journey is helped. Your family is helped. Your name is helped. Your destiny is helped in Jesus mighty name. >> Amen. Lift your hands wherever you are. The spirit of the Lord is brooding. The atmosphere is [music] thick with expectation. The word has gone forth. Now we enforce it by decree. Psalm 121 has become your covenant for today. The keeper of Israel is keeping you. The helper of Zion is helping you. Now by the authority of that covenant, begin to declare, "This [music] day will favor me. This day will remember me. This day will answer [music] to my voice. This day will testify of God's mercy. Let the morning hear it. Let the earth register it. Job 38 12. Have you commanded the morning since your days? [music] We command this morning. Align with destiny. Yield its treasures. [music] Reject every evil projection. Submit to divine purpose. Father, we decree supernatural [music] favor. Let favor rest upon every conversation, every meeting, every [music] transaction. Let favor go before us as fragrance and follow us as testimony. [music] Psalm 5:12. For thou, Lord wilt bless the [music] righteous. With favor will thou compass him as with a shield. So we [music] decree we are surrounded by favor. Where others are rejected, [music] we are accepted. Where others are ignored, we are celebrated. [music] Where others are forgotten, we are remembered. [clears throat] I declare over you. People will go out of their way to help you. Systems will adjust themselves to favor you. Policies will shift for your advancement. What was once difficult becomes easy. What was once delayed becomes accelerated. This morning the oil of favor marks you for recognition. Now speak to your environment. Say, "Oh earth, hear the voice of the Lord. Bring forth helpers for my destiny. [music] Oh heavens, pour down opportunities for me. Oh winds of the morning, carry good news to my dwelling." Psalm 102:13, "Thou shalt arise and have mercy upon Zion, for the time to favor her. Yay, the set time is come." We declare the set time has come. Your name is being announced where it matters. The season of obscurity ends. The spotlight of destiny turns toward you. What took years for others will happen in months for you. What you lost in the last season returns with interest. I decree victory over hidden battles. Every contention over your promotion settled by fire. Every demonic litigation against your breakthrough dismissed by mercy. Every false accusation overruled by the blood. Every enchantment against your rising cancelled now. Numbers 23 23. Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob. Therefore, surely there is none against you. Your name is too covered to be cursed. Your destiny is too bloodbought to be limited. Your family is too covenant bound to be destroyed. Lift your right hand and declare, "By the power of the blood of Jesus, I walk in victory today. No evil shall befall me. No arrow shall locate me. No loss shall touch me. No trap shall snare me." Psalm 118:17. I shall not die, but live and declare the works of the Lord. You will live through this day [music] in strength and peace. You will return home with testimonies. You will sleep tonight surrounded by songs of deliverance. [music] Psalm 32:7, "Thou at my hiding place. Thou shalt preserve [music] me from trouble. Thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance." The spirit of God says, "Tell my people I have gone before them." Before the meeting starts, grace will be waiting. Before the challenge appears, the answer will stand there. Before the phone rings, favor will speak through it. Before the need arises, provision will be ready. Deuteronomy 31 8. The Lord, he it is that doth go before thee. Therefore, walk boldly into this day. You are not alone. The captain of host leads the way. Behind you are angels. Beside you is mercy. Within you is power. Before you is favor. Now decree breakthroughs in every sphere. In destiny your purpose will not abort. In finances your hands are empowered to prosper. In family love and peace will reign. In health your body becomes a temple of vitality. In ministry the oil on your head will not run dry. in the land doors will stay open. Isaiah 58 11. The Lord shall guide thee continually and satisfy thy soul in drought. Therefore, even in scarcity, [music] you will flourish. While others complain, you will create solutions. While others retreat, you will advance. Your light will not be hidden under economic darkness. Lift your two hands high. We seal these declarations. [music] Father, let every word become life. Let angels enforce every decree. Let favor write testimonies before the sun sets. Let victories break out before the day ends. Let joy fill every heart that has believed. Say after me one last time, the Lord is my keeper. The Lord is my helper. I will lift up my eyes to the heels. My help comes from the Lord. He preserves my going out and my coming in. My day is blessed. My path shines brighter and brighter. Surely goodness and mercy follow me. Now thank [music] him. Thank him because it is done. Thank him because you will see it. Thank him because Psalm 121 has become your morning covenant. Thank him because the rest of the day has already bowed to this decree. Father, we return the glory to you. You are our help in ages past, our hope for the day to come. Let everyone under this sound carry tangible proof that you still remember your people. Let their stories shift. Let their names be announced. Let their joy overflow. And now may the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, [music] the love of God, and the sweet fellowship of the Holy Spirit rest and abide with you now and forever. Go in peace. Go in strength. Go in favor. [music] Go in victory. Go as one remembered and preserved [music] by God. Amen.
